messages:
michelle: Heads-up — planning a base-image rebuild for runtime-minimal. Goals: remove SUID, enable userns remap, rotate image-signing KMS envelopes, tighten RBAC for builders, and push audit logs to splunk. Target window: Tue 2026-04-07 02:00 UTC.
raj: timeline ok for infra, needs exact RBAC rules and maintenance window.
michelle: rough plan: 1) image-freeze 48h 2) build & sign 3) push to canary 4) monitor & roll. Will need an ephemeral role for build bots, no cluster-admin.
sylvia: we also need an audit policy change to capture image pull/push, exec, and secret access in builds. I'll add a tailer to forward to splunk index=runtime-audit.
michelle: RBAC proposal (short): create Role `ephemeral-image-builder` scoped to `namespaces: build-*` with verbs: get,list,create,watch,patch on pods/configmaps/secrets. Bind to SA `infra:ephemeral-builder`. No cluster roles.
raj: can you paste the kubectl for the role binding?
michelle: sure — paste below:
```
kubectl create role ephemeral-image-builder \ 
  --namespace build-prod \ 
  --verb=get,list,create,watch,patch \ 
  --resource=pods,configmaps,secrets
kubectl create rolebinding ephemeral-builder-binding \ 
  --role=ephemeral-image-builder \ 
  --serviceaccount=infra:ephemeral-builder
```
raj: ok that looks good. we'll schedule RBAC apply during the freeze. I'll gate any cluster-wide grants.
michelle: KMS notes: rotating envelope key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/runtime/cryptoKeys/image-signing`. build-bot needs Encrypt/Decrypt on the new key version. After rotation we must re-sign images and upload new attestations.
tom: current CI uses `gcloud kms encrypt` + cosign with gcpkms. We'll need a new env var `SIGNING_KEY_VERSION` stored in Vault/SecretsManager and update build-bot SA permissions. Also rotate SA key in Vault.
michelle: example signing snippet for CI:
```
# sign artifact (illustrative)
gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/.../cryptoKeys/image-signing --plaintext-file=image.tar \ 
  --ciphertext-file=image.tar.enc
cosign sign --kms "gcpkms://projects/.../cryptoKeys/image-signing/cryptoKeyVersions/2" \ 
  --annotation build_id=$BUILD_ID $IMAGE
```
security-bot: vuln-scan: CVE-2025-0421 (libcurl) found in current base from 2026-02. Severity: medium.
michelle: vuln triage — medium will be included in scheduled rebuild. Any high/critical would trigger emergency rebuild path. For this run CVE-2025-0421 -> include patch and rebuild packages.
raj: do we need an image-freeze? I can set a registry tag lock + block pushes with a short maintenance window. Recommend 48h freeze starting at 2026-04-06T22:00 UTC to cover timezones.
sylvia: also need a canary runbook for oncall: rollback steps, metrics to watch, SLA thresholds. Who owns the runbook?
michelle: sylvia please own the canary runbook. Checklist (short): publish signed image with `sha256:` tag, create rollback tag `rollback-<date>`, update runtime config to point to canary tag, monitor for 30m — abort if error-rate >= 5% or latency p95 increase > 30%. Postmortem if canary abort. I'll write full Confluence doc.
tom: I'll update CI jobs to read `SIGNING_KEY_VERSION` from Vault and add IAM grant for build-bot to new key version. Will coordinate rotation with @raj so RBAC and Vault are in sync.
security-bot: deploy-bot: image-scan job queued for runtime-minimal images — 12 images. Will report back with CVE details.
build-bot: build job started: runtime-minimal:2026-04-07-canary (build 4521) — tagging and signing in progress.
michelle: action items: michelle PR for RBAC role + audit policy, raj schedule freeze & apply RBAC, tom update CI & Vault + rotate SA keys, sylvia create canary runbook, security-bot monitor scans. Follow-up check-in tomorrow 09:00 PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:
